ETHE.label: Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF

spinoffs.note: About 10% of ETHE's ether seeded the Grayscale Ethereum Mini Trust (ETH), distributed 1:1 to holders of record on 2024-07-18.

ETHE.notes: Stakes most of its ether; net staking rewards are paid out as cash distributions (monthly since January 2026), so ether per share still declines only by the fee.

fees.note: 0.25% headline; 0.12% on the first $2.5B for 12 months
